This document outlines the equipment 
inspection I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated by M6 in 
above title block.

This device used for slowly motion Speed: 
3 rpm. The turning gear is used for turning the turbine rotor after shut down and 
reach its zero speed.

Since the turning gear is working for a limit time at shut down and beginning of 
operation (i.e. it will not work more than 180 hr/year maximum, so it does not 
need major maintenance, it needs only just inspection twice a year or even if 
some noise is heard from it.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Abou Elfetouh Shata, tested by eng. 
Ali Abd Elslam, revised by EDEPC quality control engineer Abouda Elbana , 
accepted by general director eng. Yosry Abd Elmaqsood, and approved by eng. 
Fathy Ragap head sector of Talkha Power Station.

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس. سمير عبد الجليل؛ 
 مدير عام التفتيش وضبط الجودة EDEPC منسق MPIS ومعتمد من المحاسب محمود سليمان 
 EDEPC المدير العام للتفتيش المالي ومراقبة الجودة و 
 مشرف قطاع التفتيش وضبط الجودة.

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance stuff should be 
 carrying the suitable safety category.
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل

Wear safety and healthy equipment as 
 safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
قم بإيقاف تشغيل ترس الدوران ومضخة زيت التشحيم.

Disconnect feeding current for turning gear motor and disconnect motor 
 terminals.

sections.text: Cleaning all parts of turning gear
Replace any damaged gears with other new ones (if it needed).
Install the motor of the turning gear in its place.
Check and adjust clearance between mating gears ( not exceed 0.25 mm )
Check bearing clearances ( 0.0015 x shaft dia.)
Connect the motor terminals and clean the place around the work area.
